title: NIF fusion energy yield by shot, 2022-2024

source.name: NIF Sets Power and Energy Records
source.publisher: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / National Ignition Facility

notes: Fusion energy yield from NIF's repeated ignition shots: 3.15 MJ (Dec 2022, the first net-gain shot), 3.88 MJ (Jul 2023, the highest yield to date), 3.4 MJ (early FY2024 shot) — all from a similar ~2 MJ laser input, approximate per published LLNL figures.
